subject.title: [AI-assisted] fix(memory): close cached agent and state databases in test teardowns

question: Should this test-only PR be allowed to close the broader production memory issue, or should the PR body be reworded before merge?
rationale: The code change is narrow and correct, but the body currently uses closing syntax for an open production issue whose remaining runtime cleanup is tracked separately.

options.title: Reword before merge
options.body: Change the PR body from closing syntax to related-context wording so the test-only cleanup does not close or misattribute the production issue.

options.title: Accept the closing reference
options.body: A maintainer can intentionally let this PR close the production issue only if they also decide that issue is resolved by the current database-first path and related cleanup work.
